name: effort-router
description: Shows how hard Claude thought on each turn (effort) and which model answered; can send a simple message at a lower thinking level

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: show: only show each turn's thinking level (uses no tokens); auto: a message judged simple goes at a low thinking level (a small model reads each message to decide, one call per message); off. A choice in the Thinking level panel wins over this.
